name: by-sa-synchronised
title: A CC BY-SA recording synched to a moving image is adapted material, unedited bytes and all
citations: CC BY 4.0 legal code section 1(a), repeated in CC BY-SA 4.0: where the Licensed Material is a musical work, performance or sound recording, Adapted Material is always produced where the Licensed Material is synched in timed relation with a moving image.
CC BY-SA 4.0 legal code section 3(b)(1): a shared adaptation carries a compatible licence.
Plan 253 section 3.3: audiogram, slides with moving visuals and video tools must not classify this as simple unchanged inclusion.

required.credit: "Field Recording" by Example Musician, CC BY-SA 4.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/, source https://example.org/field-recording.wav, changes: synchronised.
